title: Show fired triggers as grey full-cycle cells and omit idle checks

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fired trigger checks are aggregated into one grey full-cycle range cell; idle-only cycles have no trigger item. Icons and text removed from trigger cells, original checks remain recorded and accessible when inspecting a fired cell. Light/dark system palettes retained. Browser verified grey fill, no SVG icons, zero idle cells, and click-through trigger details. 525 Python and 7 UI tests passed. No model calls.
